parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1942 (Alpha-2B adrenergic receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
